expectations.evidence: ImageFilter trait with apply(&self, image: &mut Image) -> Result<(), FilterError> and name(&self) -> &str. All 5 filters implement it.
Each filter owns its parameters: Resize{scale}, Blur{radius}, Sharpen{amount}, Rotate{degrees}. Grayscale is a unit struct (no params needed). No shared params array.
Pipeline struct with Vec<Box<dyn ImageFilter>> and builder-style add_filter(self, ...) -> Self chaining. execute() applies filters in order with ? error propagation.

Explanation explicitly identifies Strategy (trait-based variant) and Chain of Responsibility (Vec pipeline variant). Explains why dynamic dispatch is needed for heterogeneous pipeline. Also explains why Box<dyn> over generics, Result over panic.
